title: WA Cares Fund: Employer Information
issuer: WA Cares Fund, Washington State Department of Social and Health Services

passages.question: What is the WA Cares premium on the Q3 wages, and does the Social Security cap apply?
passages.excerpt: You won’t pay any share of these contributions for your employees; you may, however, elect to pay some or all of your employees' share on their behalf. ... The premium is 0.58% of an employee’s gross wages, so: Gross wages x .0058 = total premium for employee. Note that unlike Paid Leave, premium contributions are not capped at the taxable maximum for social security. ... Once notified of an employee’s exemption, employers must: Keep a copy of the employee’s approval letter on file. Not deduct WA Cares premiums from exempt workers.
